messages:
Maya: quick sync — Customer X requested a scope lift for Private pilot. Key asks: 95th pct latency <80ms for short text requests, plus a hosted fallback for spikes. Can we map deps + owners? :eyes:
Kevin: timeline?
Maya: 6-week pilot target. Launch criteria: perf, security review (HSM/KMS hot-path), canary routing, capacity reservation.
Oli: runtime: need quantized model variant + prewarm strategy. I'll own quant profile. Est: 2w dev + 1w testing.
Sarah: infra: reserved pool + VPC peering. I'll run sizing calc by EOD tomorrow and ping customer net.
Devon: security: HSM integration for key exchanges + audit log retention. Need design review with infra/runtime. I'll draft checklist.
Kevin: product: I'll draft acceptance tests and rollback criteria. Which model variant do we expose?
Maya: expose quantized-recommended variant first. Also require automatic fallback to hosted API when Dedicated is saturated (no silent failures).
Oli: proposed fallback policy:
```
route_policy:
  primary: dedicated-quant-v1
  fallback: hosted-compatible-v1
  trigger: cpu_utilization > 85% or queue_time > 200ms
  grace_period: 30s
```
Sarah: infra deps: customer must update IP allowlist + firewall rules; timeline depends on their sec approval. Pinged infra-bot to tentatively reserve capacity.
infra-bot: reservation received. Tentative hold: 4x A40 nodes for 2w starting in 4w. Reply `approve` to confirm.
Maya: owners recap: Oli (runtime quant + prewarm), Sarah (infra sizing & peering), Devon (security/KMS), Kevin (product acceptance & rollback). I'll own launch coordination.
Kevin: immediate next actions?
Maya: 1) Oli: prototype quant + perf baseline (due in 10d)
2) Sarah: prelim capacity calc + request to customer net (due in 3d)
3) Devon: draft security checklist + supported HSM list (due in 5d)
4) Kevin: acceptance tests + rollback doc (due in 7d)
5) Maya: schedule weekly cross-team sync + customer touchpoint (invite sent)
Oli: noted — will post perf artifacts here.
Sarah: pinging infra-bot to reserve tentative slots (will cancel if not needed).
Kevin: product q — function-calling or just text gen/embeddings?
Maya: short text gen + embeddings for routing. No function-calling initially.
Devon: risk: embeddings may contain PII. Need retention policy + S3 encryption at rest. Adding to checklist.
Kevin: acceptance updated: embeddings retention <=30d, encryption at rest, redact PII in eval prompts.
Oli: perf plan: synthetic trace matching customer's 95p sizes. If dedicated can't hit 80ms, fallback must be seamless.
Sarah: infra suggestion: small burst pool (2 nodes) to absorb spikes instead of large overprovision.
Maya: tradeoff: smaller dedicated + fallback vs larger reserved pool. For pilot, prefer smaller + fallback to conserve cost.
Kevin: customer okay with fallback as long as normal traffic SLA met.
Devon: we must log fallback events to audit + alerting for compliance.
Oli: runtime will emit `fallback_event` span and metric `routed_to_hosted`.
Sarah: infra will add alert if `routed_to_hosted` > 1% over 5m.
Maya: canary plan: 10% -> 50% (manual hold) -> 100% over 48h. Auto rollback on error rate >2% or latency breach.
Oli: will add KV cache warmup to canary script.
Devon: scheduling design review w/ security + infra tomorrow 11am PT.
Maya: drafting minimal spec doc, will link after review.
Kevin: owners update thread daily; I'll compile a one-pager for AE.
Sarah: sizing calc in progress, will update.
Oli: perf baseline posted: unoptimized 95p = 92ms; quant sim 95p = 70ms. Artifact: https://internal/artifacts/quant-baseline/1789995555
Devon: security checklist draft: https://docs/internal/security/checklists/private-pilot-hsm.md
Maya: next sync in 2 days. :calendar:
Kevin: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maya: closing — converting actions to tickets after design review. Good momentum :rocket:
